decisions.reason: The source's requirement for lighting around the bowls is already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY setting bowl_lighting_required to true.
The silver button and knob details specialize the separate control-styling Requirement without changing the candidate's existing DJ-inspired visual theme.
The request to explore the previously discussed E treatment neither necessarily changes nor supersedes the existing E marking, cursive style, coverage, or color attributes.
Silver styling is specified only for buttons and knobs if a new base is built; it does not change the machine's beige primary finish or green accents.
The source does not change the placard text, position, viewing orientation, display sides, or wording.
The source's rendering reference applies specifically to buttons and knobs, not to the spout's appearance, material, or fabrication.
The conditional styling of controls on a newly built base does not alter the base graphics, logo, lettering case, font, or font color.
Specifying silver buttons and knobs does not change the support base's beige finish or finish reference.
The source expresses approval of the rendered power button's appearance but does not change the requirement for a dedicated machine power button or its control behavior.
Button and knob appearance does not change the dispensing actuation mechanism or press-and-release control behavior.
The visual-control styling decision does not alter pour quality, beverage preservation, dispensing path, dripping, sputtering, or pour sequence.
The source contains no change to splash-control targets, speed conditions, or mitigation options.
